name: 01-cover-firefight
note: Cover: first-person firefight at site A — player holds the Foundry entry with a VK-7 while Jackals cross the site, tracers live, full HUD.

name: 02-title
note: The title screen over a slow orbit of Kestrel Yard: name, mission, economy and the full control list, click to play.

name: 03-buy-menu
note: Round 1 buy phase: the buy menu with all eight purchases and prices, scoreboard, minimap and the yard behind it.

name: 04-match-end
note: The match-end screen after a full simulated match: result, final score and the ten-player K/D table, click or R to restart.
